data.title: Breathing the Mysteries

data.description: The song tells the story of a person raised inside comforting lies, taught to believe in flags, heroes, and simple truths. As the world collapses into endless conflict, those illusions shatter, revealing that every side carries the same hunger, cruelty, and manipulation. Surrounded by war, propaganda, and moral decay, the narrator refuses to choose a banner or become another weapon. Instead of fighting for victory or dominance, they fight to preserve something fragile and rare: their own humanity. The song follows an inner war, where survival is not measured by conquest, but by resisting hatred, refusing corruption, and staying human in a world that rewards monsters. It is a story of quiet defiance, moral isolation, and persistence against becoming what one despises.
data.title: Still Breathing
